item.title: Takayama Sanmachi Suji: A Beautifully Preserved Merchant Old Town — Guide
item.description: Sanmachi Suji is the beautifully preserved heart of Takayama’s old town, a cluster of narrow lanes lined with dark wooden merchant houses dating from the Edo period, when the town prospered as a centre of skilled carpenters and merchants in the mountainous Hida region. Today the lanes are home to sake breweries marked by cedar-ball signs, cafes, craft shops, and stalls selling Hida beef and local sweets, making it one of Japan’s most atmospheric and enjoyable historic districts to explore on foot.
